title: Oaks Modernized
body:
This Resource Pack was created for "[ArcticDucc292](https://www.reddit.com/r/Minecraft/comments/1m02u36/comment/n380j2s/?context=3)" on Reddit.

This Resource Pack brings the 1.14+ texture update to 1.12 for those who still use modpacks and/or play on that version, but just want the game to still look like the current Minecraft! It's simple, not much more to say
